exposure: Women with vesicouterine or vesicocervical fistula
outcome: Type of genitourinary fistula (vesicovaginal, vesicouterine/vesicocervical, ureterovaginal)
cohort: 2091 women presenting for genitourinary fistula evaluation at the International Organization for Women and Development in Kigali, Rwanda, between February 1, 2013, and October 31, 2017
finding: There was a significant increase in the proportion of vesicouterine, vesicocervical, and ureterovaginal fistulas among women presenting in Rwanda over the 5-year period, with the majority occurring after cesarean section.
mod_finding: The majority of vesicouterine, vesicocervical, and ureterovaginal fistulas occurred after cesarean section.
